findings.issue_text: [High/bug] themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties:101 — the new `totpStep1` value ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") is Italian, replacing the previous correct Lithuanian text in the Lithuanian locale file (apparent copy-paste from the it.properties fix); Lithuanian users will see Italian during TOTP setup.

[Medium/bug] misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:~67 — in the English-file path derivation, the character class `[a-zA-Z-_]` puts `-` before `_`, so Java parses `-_` as the range U+002D–U+005F, which includes `.`, `/`, digits, `<`, `>`. The pattern `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` can therefore match across directory separators: any `_` earlier in the absolute path (CI workspace, checkout dir like `/home/ci_user/...`) makes the leftmost match swallow the rest of the path, producing a bogus English path and a `RuntimeException` build failure. Use `[a-zA-Z_-]` or derive the sibling file via `File` APIs.

[Medium/bug] themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:112 — the new `totpStep1` is written in Traditional Chinese ("在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：") inside the Simplified-Chinese (zh_CN) bundle, leaving the file mixing scripts (totpStep2/3 are simplified); it should be simplified, e.g. "在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：".

[Medium/bug] js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138 and js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188 — `error-invalid-multivalued-size` changed from `{{n}}` placeholders to `{n}` plus a Java MessageFormat `choice` pattern (`{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`). The previous `{{n}}` syntax implies a double-brace interpolator (i18next-style); if the JS UIs' formatter doesn't implement `java.text.MessageFormat` semantics, the message will render with literal `{0}`/`{2,choice,...}` tokens. Need to confirm the formatting layer supports this, and that all other locale files containing this key were updated consistently (only the `_en` files are visible in this diff).

[Low/bug] VerifyMessageProperties.java:~62–72 — `verifySafeHtml()` throws a bare `RuntimeException` on unreadable/missing English files, inconsistent with `verify()`'s `MojoExecutionException` handling; any community message file without a product `_en` counterpart (or a derived path broken by the regex issue) crashes the build instead of being reported or skipped gracefully.

[Low/bug] VerifyMessageProperties.java:~108 (`normalizeValue`) — the `{n,choice,...}` sanitizer workaround is allow-listed by key name (`error-invalid-multivalued-size`, `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*`). Since this PR itself introduces choice syntax into the bundles, any other key that later adopts it will fail verification until hand-added to this list; the choice pattern should be handled generically instead of per-key.

[Low/test_gap] misc/theme-verifier/src/test/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessagePropertiesTest.java — tests only cover failure detection; there is no positive test that a valid translation (allowed HTML matching the English source, identical anchors) produces zero messages, and no coverage of the English-path derivation edge cases (underscore-containing paths, `_zh_CN`-style filenames) or the missing-English-key/file paths — exactly where the new logic is most fragile.

[Low/data] js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3141 — pre-existing corruption visible in this hunk: the orphaned line "to the attribute. For that, make sure to use any of the built-in validators…" has no `key=` and is parsed as a garbage key, while `multivaluedHelp` above it is truncated mid-sentence. Since this PR is cleaning up message resources (and the new verifier silently tolerates the empty-value garbage key), this should be repaired here.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:~67 — in the English-file path derivation, the character class `[a-zA-Z-_]` puts `-` before `_`, so Java parses `-_` as the range U+002D–U+005F, which includes `.`, `/`, digits, `<`, `>`. The pattern `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` can therefore match across directory separators: any `_` earlier in the absolute path (CI workspace, checkout dir like `/home/ci_user/...`) makes the leftmost match swallow the rest of the path, producing a bogus English path and a `RuntimeException` build failure. Use `[a-zA-Z_-]` or derive the sibling file via `File` APIs.

adjudication.rationale: In `VerifyMessageProperties.verifySafeHtml()`, the English file path is derived via `file.getAbsolutePath()...replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties")`. The character class `[a-zA-Z-_]` treats `-` as a range operator (effectively `Z-_`), which includes characters like `[` `\` `]` `^` `_`. Notably it includes backslash (`\\`), so on Windows an underscore earlier in the absolute path (e.g. `C:\ci_user\...`) can cause the regex to match across path separators up to the final `.properties`, producing a bogus `englishFile` and triggering the `RuntimeException` when opening it. This defect is introduced by the diff’s new English-path derivation logic.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138 and js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188 — `error-invalid-multivalued-size` changed from `{{n}}` placeholders to `{n}` plus a Java MessageFormat `choice` pattern (`{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`). The previous `{{n}}` syntax implies a double-brace interpolator (i18next-style); if the JS UIs' formatter doesn't implement `java.text.MessageFormat` semantics, the message will render with literal `{0}`/`{2,choice,...}` tokens. Need to confirm the formatting layer supports this, and that all other locale files containing this key were updated consistently (only the `_en` files are visible in this diff).

adjudication.rationale: The diff does show `error-invalid-multivalued-size` changing from `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}}` to `{0}/{1}/{2}` plus a MessageFormat `choice` fragment in both `js/apps/.../messages_en.properties` files. However, the claim that the JS UIs' formatter does *not* support `java.text.MessageFormat` (and would therefore render literals like `{2,choice,...}`) is not verifiable from this diff alone. What *is* verifiable is that this is a nontrivial formatting-layer assumption change that should be confirmed, and the diff does not show corresponding updates for all locales for those JS-app message bundles.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] VerifyMessageProperties.java:~62–72 — `verifySafeHtml()` throws a bare `RuntimeException` on unreadable/missing English files, inconsistent with `verify()`'s `MojoExecutionException` handling; any community message file without a product `_en` counterpart (or a derived path broken by the regex issue) crashes the build instead of being reported or skipped gracefully.

adjudication.rationale: In `VerifyMessageProperties.verify()`, IO errors are converted to `MojoExecutionException`, but the newly added `verifySafeHtml()` reads both the target bundle and a derived English bundle and on `IOException` throws a bare `RuntimeException` (two `catch (IOException e) { throw new RuntimeException(...) }` blocks). The English file path is synthesized via `replaceAll("resources-community", "resources")` and `replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties")`; if that derived file is missing/unreadable, the verifier will crash the build rather than report a message/skip, which is inconsistent with the surrounding error-handling shown in the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] VerifyMessageProperties.java:~108 (`normalizeValue`) — the `{n,choice,...}` sanitizer workaround is allow-listed by key name (`error-invalid-multivalued-size`, `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*`). Since this PR itself introduces choice syntax into the bundles, any other key that later adopts it will fail verification until hand-added to this list; the choice pattern should be handled generically instead of per-key.

adjudication.rationale: In VerifyMessageProperties.normalizeValue(), the code strips ICU-style choice patterns only for specific keys: `key.startsWith("linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit") || key.equals("error-invalid-multivalued-size")` and replaces `\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}` with `...`. The diff also introduces `{2,choice,...|1<...}` syntax into `error-invalid-multivalued-size` messages. As written, any other message key that later uses `{n,choice,...}` will not get normalized and is more likely to be flagged by the HTML sanitizer/verification (the code comment explicitly cites the `<` in choice). This is a maintainability/scalability concern created by the current implementation, not a direct functional defect in this PR.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/test_gap] misc/theme-verifier/src/test/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessagePropertiesTest.java — tests only cover failure detection; there is no positive test that a valid translation (allowed HTML matching the English source, identical anchors) produces zero messages, and no coverage of the English-path derivation edge cases (underscore-containing paths, `_zh_CN`-style filenames) or the missing-English-key/file paths — exactly where the new logic is most fragile.

adjudication.rationale: The updated tests in VerifyMessagePropertiesTest.java only assert failure cases (duplicateKeys_en.properties, illegalHtmlTag_en.properties, noHtml_de.properties, changedAnchor_de.properties) and do not include a “valid translation passes” case that would exercise the success path of verifySafeHtml() producing zero messages. Additionally, the new English-file derivation logic in VerifyMessageProperties.verifySafeHtml() (building englishFile via replaceAll("resources-community", "resources") and replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties")) plus the missing-English handling in getEnglishValue() (returns "" on MissingResourceException) and missing-English-file behavior (IOException -> RuntimeException) are untested, which is a concrete gap given this is new nontrivial, potentially fragile logic.

For that, make sure to use any of the built-in validators…" has no `key=` and is parsed as a garbage key, while `multivaluedHelp` above it is truncated mid-sentence. Since this PR is cleaning up message resources (and the new verifier silently tolerates the empty-value garbage key), this should be repaired here.

adjudication.rationale: In `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties`, the hunk clearly contains a stray line `to the attribute. For that, make sure...` that is not a `key=value` entry and is not a valid continuation of `multivaluedHelp` (no line-continuation `\`). In Java `.properties` parsing this will be interpreted as a separate unintended property (garbage key/value) and `multivaluedHelp` will remain truncated, which is a real correctness defect in the resource file. The diff also adds `verifySafeHtml()` but nothing in it would flag this malformed/garbage property entry, so the PR touches the area and leaves the defect in place.
